nodes.label: README - Family Kitchen Recipes
nodes.description: Project overview: web application for storing family recipes, calculating macros via OpenAI, managing weekly menus, and generating smart shopping lists with warehouse integration.
nodes.rationale: Documents the full stack (Python 3.12 + FastAPI + SQLAlchemy async + Alembic, React 18 + Vite, PostgreSQL 16, Nginx, Docker Compose) and all major feature areas.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml
nodes.description: Docker Compose v3.9 definition with four services: db (postgres:16-alpine), backend (FastAPI), frontend (React+Express), and volumes for postgres_data, uploads_data, documents_data.
nodes.rationale: Backend depends on db health check; frontend connects to backend via BACKEND_ORIGIN env var; no nginx service defined here (nginx lives in web-folders stack per deploy script).

nodes.label: frontend/index.html
nodes.description: Vite SPA entry point. Loads Google Fonts (Dela Gothic One, Nunito) and mounts React app via /src/main.jsx into #root div.

nodes.label: backend/requirements.txt
nodes.description: Python dependencies: FastAPI 0.115, Uvicorn, SQLAlchemy async 2.0, asyncpg, aiosqlite, Alembic, Pydantic v2, pydantic-settings, python-jose, passlib/bcrypt, httpx, aiofiles, openai 1.109, pytest, pytest-asyncio.

nodes.label: .github/workflows/pr-main-tests.yml
nodes.description: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on PRs to main. Runs backend (pytest) and frontend (npm run test:run) tests in parallel, then a status-check job requiring both to pass.
nodes.rationale: Provides a required status check gate so broken PRs cannot be merged to main without all tests passing.

nodes.label: .github/workflows/deploy-vps.yml
nodes.description: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on push to main or manual dispatch. Runs backend and frontend tests, then deploys to VPS via SSH. Uses web-folders docker compose stack, health-checks via nginx, and rolls back to previous commit if health check fails.
nodes.rationale: Deploy is decoupled from the project's own docker-compose.yml; the shared web-folders stack owns nginx and orchestrates recipes-backend, recipes-frontend, and recipes-db containers. Rollback on health-check failure prevents broken deployments.

nodes.label: FastAPI Backend Service
nodes.description: Python 3.12 FastAPI application with async SQLAlchemy, Alembic migrations, JWT auth, OpenAI integration for macro calculation.

nodes.label: React 18 Frontend SPA
nodes.description: React 18 + Vite SPA served by Express (server.js). Google Fonts loaded in index.html.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 16 Database
nodes.description: postgres:16-alpine container with health check. Used by backend via asyncpg.

nodes.label: OpenAI Macro Calculation Integration
nodes.description: Background macro (КБЖУ) calculation via OpenAI API with up to 3 retries. Configured via OPENAI_API_KEY env var.
nodes.rationale: Offloads nutritional calculation to LLM to avoid maintaining a nutrition database. Fallback logic ensures resilience when API is unavailable.

nodes.label: web-folders Shared Docker Stack
nodes.description: Separate VPS repository (web-folders) that owns the shared nginx reverse proxy and orchestrates multiple projects including family-kitchen-recipes containers.
nodes.rationale: Centralises nginx config and TLS termination for multiple services on one VPS, avoiding per-project nginx containers.

nodes.label: Smart Shopping List Feature
nodes.description: Aggregates purchase ingredients from uncooked menu dishes, scales by servings, rounds up, deduplicates using synonym/phrase aliases, and cross-checks against warehouse stock.
nodes.rationale: Per-serving scaling and upward rounding prevent under-buying. Synonym matching reduces false 'not in stock' results for multi-word ingredient names.

nodes.label: Warehouse (Склад) Feature
nodes.description: Tracks on-hand products (В наличии) and prepared batches (Заготовки). Automatically used when generating the shopping list.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.description: JWT-based authentication using python-jose and passlib/bcrypt. Two hardcoded users initialised from env vars (USER1_NAME/PASSWORD, USER2_NAME/PASSWORD).
nodes.rationale: Simple two-user model avoids a full user management system for a private family application.

nodes.label: CI/CD Pipeline
nodes.description: Full CI/CD: PR tests gate merges; push-to-main triggers test + deploy with health-check rollback.
nodes.rationale: Health-check rollback ensures the live service is always in a working state even if a deployment introduces a regression.

nodes.label: Alembic Database Migrations
nodes.description: Seven versioned migrations (0001–0007) covering initial schema, dry-frying, warehouse, warehouse timestamps, family members, birth date, and menu meal slots.
